dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

The Pawdacity arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, he has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to hard stare and growl at handkickers when approached. While on leash he walks with a lowered body and cowers when people walk close to them. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: The Pawdacity
